description.en: Craft Context for DeepSeek Desktop: governed knowledge, scoped memory, routeable experience and checkpoint-pinned codebase analysis in one entry point.
description.zh: Craft Context 的 DeepSeek Desktop 插件：知识、记忆、经验与代码库分析四合一入口，全部受治理、可溯源。

description.en: Craft's default aggregate entry: Knowledge, Memory, Experience and Codebase on one Runtime, returning governed material and a receipt from a single context resolution. Exposed to DSH as craft_context_info / craft_context_tools / craft_context_call, with the MCP runtime and Skill bundled.
description.zh: Craft 的默认聚合入口：知识、记忆、经验与代码库四个子能力共用一个 Runtime，一次上下文解析返回受治理材料与回执。DSH 侧以 craft_context_info / craft_context_tools / craft_context_call 三个工具暴露，内置 MCP runtime 与 Skill。
